stories.title: Two pages, six employees, every line agreeing
Five allowances for one employee
stories.recipe: Every allowance is a component; none is folded into one gross.

stories.title: A loan installment twice, under two line IDs
stories.recipe: Two installments of 500.00 with two line IDs are two deductions, and the net counts both.

stories.title: One line printed again after a page break, footed as printed
stories.recipe: The housing line L-0002 is on both pages and every total foots the printed pages; only its line ID shows it twice.

stories.title: An employee's block printed twice
stories.recipe: Each page foots itself; the run total does not count E-5002 twice.

stories.title: One employee in two cost centres
stories.recipe: Two centres, two nets, one payee account of one employee: nothing is shared.

stories.title: One employee in two cost centres with one net line
stories.recipe: The net printed under ICU pays both centres; the centres are not merged to make it fit.

stories.title: Employer contribution kept beside net, and taken from it
stories.recipe: E-8002's net takes the employer's 1,468.75 out of the employee's pay.

stories.title: A zero overtime line, written
stories.recipe: 0.00 is a component the system printed; it stays in the lines.

stories.title: A blank amount on the last page
stories.recipe: The blank transport is not zero, and without it no total can be checked.

stories.title: Two employees with equal lines
stories.recipe: Equal amounts and components never make two employees one.

stories.title: Two employees paid into one payee account
stories.recipe: The shared account is listed for the accountant; it is not the employee.

stories.title: A page break inside one employee's lines
stories.recipe: E-1302's earnings end one page and its deductions and net open the next.

stories.title: A page from a supplementary run
stories.recipe: The bonus page belongs to another run and counts nowhere.

stories.title: The last page never arrived
stories.recipe: Every employee that arrived is consistent; the run totals say a page is missing.

stories.title: Two payee accounts for one employee
stories.recipe: The net line names another account than the earnings.

stories.title: Two net lines for one employee
stories.recipe: The two nets add up to the equation, but a split payment needs its own contract.

stories.title: An employee without a net line
A line whose kind is written allowance
stories.recipe: Allowance is not a kind; the transport could be any of the four.

stories.title: A line whose employee's dimensions are blank
stories.recipe: The housing line is not inherited from the line above it.

stories.title: A page footer between two pages
stories.recipe: Nothing says the footer holds no line.

stories.title: A file cut off inside its last page
stories.recipe: The last page stops after four lines: no totals, no end, no run totals.

stories.title: A page whose header lost its posting date
stories.recipe: Without its posting date the page could belong to another run; E-2302 is not read, so the run totals, which count it, do not foot either.

stories.title: Columns in another order on each page
A page with a Notes column
stories.recipe: Eight columns are not the seven; the page is not read and the run does not foot.

stories.title: One section ID on two pages
A page total off by one halala
stories.recipe: The page cannot vouch for its two employees; the other page and the run still foot.

stories.title: Two opposite components raised, the net unchanged
stories.recipe: E-2801's basic and its insurance each rose by 500.00 after the totals were printed; its net still balances, the footings do not.

stories.title: Kuwaiti dinars in Arabic-Indic digits, Arabic dimensions
stories.recipe: Three decimals, Arabic-Indic digits and the Arabic decimal separator read as amounts.

stories.title: A line ID that reads as a formula
stories.recipe: The line still foots; its identity does not read.

stories.title: Yen with a fraction
stories.recipe: Yen has no decimals; 51187.5 is refused, not rounded.

stories.title: Employee IDs with and without a leading zero
stories.recipe: 0420's net was printed as 420; the zero is never restored, and the shared payee account is the clue left for the accountant.

stories.title: A scope whose period ends before it starts
A register saved in Windows Arabic
A quote inside an unquoted component
Run totals of the supplementary run
stories.recipe: The figures foot, but the block says it totals another run.

stories.title: The column row printed again inside a page
stories.recipe: A second column row is a line by the contract (P7): its words are not a kind or an amount, so nothing foots until it is removed.

stories.title: 120 employees across six pages
stories.recipe: One employee a halala short, one without a net line, two sharing a payee account.
